treasury.name: 10-year US Treasury yield (EOD Historical Data, from the US Treasury)

damodaran-returns.name: Damodaran, NYU Stern, yearly S&P 500 returns with dividends
damodaran-returns.note: 1928 to 2025 compounds to 10.0% a year: the ~10% every card is measured against.

sec-eod.name: Company filings (SEC EDGAR) and prices (EOD Historical Data)
sec-eod.note: Profit is the twelve months to the latest quarterly report, per share after dilution. Cash returned is dividends paid over the last twelve months (EOD); buybacks show up in profit-per-share growth. Next year’s profit is last year’s, grown at the analysts’ forecast rate (Alpha Vantage).

alphavantage.name: Alpha Vantage, analysts’ average profit-per-share forecasts
alphavantage.note: Next year’s profit grows last year’s official profit at the forecast rate for the next fiscal year.

spx-quotes.name: S&P 500 years of next year’s forecast profit: quoted figure (Yahoo Finance, StockAnalysis)

rough.name: Design-stage estimate
rough.note: SpaceX: its listing document has no machine-readable figures; replaced at its first annual report.

shiller.name: Robert Shiller’s S&P 500 data (profit, dividends and total return per index share, and US consumer prices)

private.name: Private companies: the value at the latest funding round or staff share sale, and the revenue and losses the companies reported to investors, as published by Reuters, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal and The Information
private.note: Not audited, and typed in by hand. Anthropic $965 billion (funding round, May 2026), OpenAI $852 billion (funding round, March 2026), Stripe $159 billion (staff share sale, February 2026), ByteDance $550 billion (stake sale, early 2026, Reuters), Revolut $115 billion (staff share sale, July 2026, The Wall Street Journal), Canva $34.9 billion (two early investors' valuation of their stakes, August 2026; its last share sale, in August 2025, was at $42 billion). Profit: ByteDance $42–50 billion in 2025 (Bloomberg and others, from people familiar); Revolut $1.7 billion in 2025 (its audited annual report).

spx-gains.name: S&P 500 profit without gains on investments: Shiller’s profit as reported, less the gains inside the board’s S&P 500 companies’ profit (their filings), and the index’s price less their stakes in other companies; the index’s total value from Seeking Alpha’s Fall 2026 snapshot (end of September 2026), carried forward with its level; members from Wikipedia’s list of S&P 500 companies
spx-gains.note: October 2026: the gains were about 10% of the index’s profit, mostly at Alphabet, Amazon, Berkshire Hathaway and Nvidia, which moved it from 26 to 29 years of profit. The other members’ gains are left in.
